title: Representational Geometry of Multimodal Brain-Language Alignments
authors: Dongyeop Han & Jiook Cha (SNU Connectome Lab)
summaryPoints: Critiques the traditional linear regression assumption between LLM activations and fMRI responses.
Proves that nonlinear multimodal mappings unveil higher-order semantic geometry encoded in associative cortex.
Bridges the gap between Buzsáki's inside-out brain framework and autoregressive Transformer internal states.
significance: Re-evaluates the mathematical foundation of how artificial neural representations correspond to biological neural manifolds.
labRelevance: Foundational theoretical grounding for the Neuro-X Large Brain Model.
